$comment: The skins contract's LOCAL validation target (Appearance token model v2). Token value types are NOT defined here: every manifest/resolved document is validated against the vendored canonical set under skins/contracts/ (see canonical.delegates and skins/contracts/PIN). The canonical schemas type every length as a unitless JSON number rendered as CSS px, font-weight as unitless, and letter-spacing as a unitless ratio rendered as em; a numeric string such as "12px" is rejected. This file adds only the frozen local envelope (schema_major + the five v2 groups + optional mode overrides + the optional root host policy) and the palette/forbidden metadata. The vendored appearance-json schema validates the resolved runtime tokens.json (version 2 + the five fully resolved groups); the vendored appearance-artifact schema validates appearance.json. CSS targets are named <configDir>.gtk.css.j2 (rendered <configDir>.css); non-CSS artifacts are named <consumer>.<format>.j2 (rendered <consumer>.<format>), with rasi shipping first and conf/theme reserved. Both families expand flattened v2 placeholder paths. Layout tokens are TSX-owned and templates MUST NOT emit them as CSS. Re-vendoring must update the PIN hashes and canonical.tag together; schema_major moves independently of the repo tag.
title: dotfiles-assets appearance manifest v2

legacy.note: The v1 skin schemas are vendored at v0.11.0 for provenance only. This class emits v2 manifests and resolved tokens.json; it never mixes a v1 token map with a v2 artifact.

resolved_document.note: The runtime emits one generation tokens.json: version 2 plus the five fully resolved groups, with mode overrides already applied. Consumers validate that resolved document directly against this vendored schema, without the manifest wrapper.

canonical.note: Byte-for-byte copies of the canonical appearance, generation and frozen v1 skin schemas are vendored under skins/contracts/ and pinned by sha256 in skins/contracts/PIN. The pinned tag is v0.11.0, the rectangle-radii release: the optional [host] allowlist covers surface.panel.radius, surface.panel.border-width, surface.card.radius, surface.control.radius and surface.cell.radius, while surface.pill.radius is deliberately absent so the capsule identity stays explicit. The token vocabulary is surface.{panel,card,cell,control,pill}, state.{hover,selected,focus,disabled}, type, ink, layout.<app>, optional mode.dark/mode.light overrides and the optional root [host] policy. [host] is a policy object, not a token group, with mode override > host > skin fallback; no padding, gap, type, paint, colour, state, layout or non-panel border-width path is delegable. The generation manifest schema is vendored for contract-byte parity and records the same five delegated paths in host.defaults; this class emits skin/appearance documents, not generations and never writes an artifact path. CSS targets are named <configDir>.gtk.css.j2 (rendered <configDir>.css), including gtk3/gtk4; non-CSS artifacts are named <consumer>.<format>.j2 (rendered <consumer>.<format>), with rofi/rasi required and conf/theme reserved. Layout tokens stay in the manifest and tokens.json for skinValue() but are TSX-owned: templates MUST NOT expand them into CSS.

palette.source: icons/mappings/vocabulary.json (the declared role vocabulary of record in this repository; 50 theme-producer Material roles + on_backdrop, REQ-022)
palette.note: A surface/state/ink expression may name only one of these roles. Producer aliases (foreground, accent, accent-muted, warning) and colorN carrier indices are not roles; the validator rejects them.

notes: A skin is appearance: surface paint/geometry, interaction state, type, ink and mode overrides. Structure (which widget sits where) and variant names belong to the app.
surface/state/ink values are palette-role expressions or transparent; a literal hex colour is never a skin value.
GTK 4.24 ignores transitions, so the format forbids them rather than shipping dead declarations.
layout.<app> is a metric namespace consumed by skinValue(); templates MUST NOT expand it into CSS.

The wlogout target maps wide action-card buttons to surface.card fill/border/padding and surface.panel border-width/radius; glass/paper/terminal-host therefore follow delegated panel and rectangle-radius host geometry while terminal and flat stay explicit. Hover/focus keep the card fill and change only state ring/ink; active keeps state.selected fill/ink/ring.

terminal-host is the opt-in Hyprland-following variant of terminal: its base tokens are identical to terminal, and surface.panel.radius/border-width plus surface.card/control/cell.radius are delegated through [host]. The pill radius stays explicit. terminal stays [host]-free and explicit.

gtk3 and gtk4 are ordinary CSS targets with global, conservative selector allowlists. GTK3 must not use custom properties or colour-mixing; both sheets use only named colours/alpha compositing and may not emit layout, size, structure or transition declarations.

rofi is a rasi artifact, not a CSS target: solid hyphenated palette roles plus px geometry only. rasi has no alpha compositing and rejects underscore role names; typography is deferred until a Pango unit rule exists. btop and kitty remain palette-only, so no theme/conf template ships in this tag.
An override group replaces the base group as a whole; there is no deep merge.
